content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission has issued Detailed Notification No. 37/2026 dated 10 November 2026 for 720 Executive and Non-Executive Group-II Services posts. The official 98-page notification contains post-wise vacancy details, category-wise reservation, educational qualifications, age limits, salaries, examination schemes, Screening Test and Mains syllabus, Computer Proficiency Test, application instructions and selection rules. Official Notification PDF: Download APPSC Group 2 Detailed Notification 2026

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Important: The APPSC Group 2 Screening Test date is confirmed in the detailed notification. Candidates should not confuse the Screening Test scheduled for 21 February 2027 with the Main Examination, whose date has not yet been announced.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Vacancy 2026 - 720 Posts
content_sections.text: Notification No. 37/2026 announces 720 vacancies , comprising 471 Executive and 249 Non-Executive posts across various Andhra Pradesh Government services. The 203 Deputy Tahsildar vacancies include one carried-forward vacancy, while the 29 Prohibition and Excise Sub-Inspector vacancies include two carried-forward vacancies.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification from a recognized university as on 10 November 2026 , the date of the detailed notification. Most Group-II posts require a recognized Bachelor's degree. However, Finance Department Assistant Section Officer, Law Department Assistant Section Officer and Accountant posts have specific degree or additional computer qualification requirements. Yes, for many posts. Candidates with a recognized Bachelor's degree in any discipline can apply for several Executive and Non-Executive categories, including Deputy Tahsildar, Deputy Mandal Parishad Development Officer and Junior Office Assistant. However, some posts have additional academic requirements. Candidates must check the qualification corresponding to each post code before selecting their preferences. The notification prescribes a degree qualification together with one of the specified computer certificate courses or an accepted computer-related degree. Recognized computer certificate courses include: Office Automation PC Maintenance and Troubleshooting Web Designing Alternatively, candidates possessing accepted qualifications such as BCA, B.Sc. Computer Science, B.Com. Computers, B.A. Computers or B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science or Information Technology may satisfy the prescribed alternative qualification route. Important: The degree and computer qualification conditions must be read together. Possessing only a general graduation qualification should not be assumed sufficient for Accountant posts without checking the additional requirements. Candidates applying for Post Code 07 must satisfy the prescribed physical and medical standards. Eligible ST male candidates may receive the prescribed height relaxation to 160 cm under the notification's conditions. Specific departmental employees are covered by a separate 163 cm standard. The notification also requires prescribed near and distant vision, including 6/6 distant vision in both eyes, and lists medical disqualifications such as colour blindness and specified physical conditions.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit varies according to the position. Age is calculated as on 1 July 2026 . content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Salary 2026
content_sections.text: APPSC Group-II posts carry different pay scales under the applicable Andhra Pradesh Government pay structure. The starting basic pay ranges from Rs. 25,220 to Rs. 45,830 , depending on the post. Salary Clarification: These figures are Government pay scales, not guaranteed monthly take-home salary. Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance and other applicable benefits depend on Government service rules and posting conditions.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The standard application fee is Rs. 330 , comprising a Rs. 250 application processing fee and Rs. 80 examination fee. Important: Eligible categories are exempt only from the Rs. 80 examination fee. The Rs. 250 application processing fee remains payable. The notification prescribes online payment through Net Banking, Debit Card or Credit Card. Application fees are non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process includes a Screening Test, Main Examination, qualifying Computer Proficiency Test and applicable certificate verification. Screening Test: Offline OMR-based objective examination for shortlisting. Main Examination: Computer-based objective examination carrying 300 marks. Computer Proficiency Test: Qualifying test for shortlisted candidates. Certificate Verification: Verification of qualifications, age, category and local status. Final Selection: Merit based on Main Examination marks, subject to qualifying CPT and fulfilling all eligibility conditions. The Commission proposes to admit candidates to the Main Examination in a ratio of 50 times the number of vacancies , irrespective of community, subject to the notification's provisions.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Screening Test Pattern 2027
content_sections.text: The APPSC Group-II Screening Test is scheduled for 21 February 2027 and will be held in offline OMR mode. The syllabus covers Indian history, Indian and Andhra Pradesh geography, social issues, current affairs, logical reasoning, numerical ability and data analysis.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Mains Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Main Examination consists of two objective papers carrying 150 marks each , making a total of 300 marks. The examination will be held in CBRT mode. Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh. Important dynasties and historical developments. Social and cultural reform movements in Andhra Pradesh. Andhra Pradesh formation and related developments. Indian Constitution and its basic structure. Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles and Fundamental Duties. Union and State Government institutions. Constitutional bodies, governance and related topics. Indian Economy. Andhra Pradesh Economy. Economic planning, agriculture, industries and development. Public finance and economic policy. Science and Technology. Applications of scientific and technological developments. Environment, energy and contemporary scientific issues. Candidates should refer to the full subject-wise syllabus in Annexure-II of the detailed notification for complete topics and subtopics. Both the Screening Test and Main Examination carry negative marking of one-third of the marks allotted to each incorrect answer . For a one-mark question, an incorrect answer results in a deduction of one-third mark.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Computer Proficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted after the Main Examination must qualify in the Computer Proficiency Test (CPT). Important: The CPT is qualifying in nature. Final recruitment merit is based on the Main Examination, subject to the candidate qualifying in CPT and meeting all other selection conditions.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Minimum Qualifying Marks 2026
content_sections.text: These are the minimum qualifying percentages stated for selection in the notification. The Commission may separately fix Screening Test shortlisting standards. Obtaining the minimum qualifying marks does not guarantee selection. Final selection depends on examination merit, eligibility, reservation and the number of available vacancies.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Local Reservation Rules 2026
content_sections.text: The notification provides 95% local reservation for designated zonal and district-cadre positions under the applicable Andhra Pradesh Presidential Order, 2025. For zonal-cadre posts, Andhra Pradesh is divided into six zones. Local candidature is determined using the study or residence conditions specified in the notification, generally involving the relevant four-year or seven-year period ending with Class VII. Important: Candidates who studied in educational institutions must ordinarily provide study certificates. Residence certificates are not accepted as replacements where the notification requires study certificates.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Reservation 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation is provided according to Andhra Pradesh Government rules for SC, ST, BC, EWS and applicable horizontal reservation categories. Women: 33 1/3% horizontal reservation, as applicable. Meritorious Sportspersons: 3% horizontal reservation under the notified rules. Ex-Servicemen: 2% horizontal reservation for notified Non-Executive categories. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities: Reservation according to the post-specific suitability rules. SC/ST/BC/EWS: Applicable vertical reservation according to Government rules. The notification specifies that candidates belonging to reserved categories of other states are not entitled to Andhra Pradesh's state-specific community reservation benefits. BC Non-Creamy Layer certificates must satisfy the specified issue-date conditions. EWS applicants must possess the prescribed digitally issued Income and Asset Certificate based on financial year 2025–26.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for 720 APPSC Group-II Services vacancies through the official APPSC application portal. Apply Online: APPSC Official Recruitment Portal Notification: 37/2026. Application Start Date: 10 November 2026. Application Last Date: 11 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Important: Creating an OTPR profile does not mean the candidate has applied for Notification No. 37/2026. A separate recruitment-specific application and successful payment are required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for APPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website psc.ap.gov.in . Read APPSC Group-II Services Notification No. 37/2026. If you are a new applicant, complete One Time Profile Registration (OTPR). Enter the required personal details, educational qualifications, contact information and other profile data. Save the generated OTPR ID and login credentials. Existing applicants should log in using their registered OTPR ID and password. Verify all profile information before applying. Open the Online Application Submission section. Find Notification No. 37/2026 and select the Fill Application option. Enter the required local/non-local status information. Provide category, reservation and applicable fee-concession details. Enter educational qualifications and select eligible post preferences. Choose the prescribed examination-centre preferences. Check the application preview carefully. Click Save & Submit to generate the payment link. Pay the applicable examination and processing fees through the online payment gateway. Confirm successful submission. Download the completed application PDF. Retain the payment reference number and application copy. Complete the entire process before 11 December 2026 at 11:59 PM . Important: Selecting only Save does not submit the application. Candidates must select Save & Submit and complete payment for the application to be treated as submitted.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: The Commission provides a limited online correction facility for eligible application fields after the application closing date. Candidates should carefully check their application before final submission. The notification does not permit unrestricted changes after the deadline, and subsequent changes made only in the OTPR profile do not automatically update the already submitted recruitment application.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for APPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following records ready for application and certificate verification, as applicable: Recognized Bachelor's degree certificate. Degree marksheets and other prescribed academic records. SSC / Class 10 certificate or accepted date-of-birth proof. OTPR registration details. Active mobile number and email address. Photo identity proof. Study certificates covering the relevant Class I to VII period. Residence certificate where specifically permitted. SC/ST/BC community certificate, if applicable. BC Non-Creamy Layer certificate, if applicable. EWS Income and Asset Certificate, if applicable. PwBD certificate, if applicable. Ex-Servicemen/NCC/sports eligibility documents, where applicable. White Card or applicable fee-concession declaration, if claiming exemption. Computer qualification certificate for prescribed Accountant categories. Law degree or other post-specific qualification certificate, where required. Other supporting records requested during verification. The commission may reject applications containing incorrect eligibility, local-status or reservation claims, even after provisional admission to an examination.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Exam Centres 2027
content_sections.text: The Screening Test and Main Examination are planned at district examination centres across Andhra Pradesh. Candidates can indicate three examination-centre preferences for the Screening Test and Main Examination. However, APPSC reserves the right to allot an examination centre other than the candidate's preferred centres depending on availability and administrative requirements.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Hall Ticket 2027
content_sections.text: The APPSC Group 2 Screening Test Hall Ticket will be released through the Commission's official website before the examination scheduled for 21 February 2027 . The exact hall ticket release date has not been announced in the detailed notification. Candidates should regularly visit psc.ap.gov.in for hall tickets, examination instructions, schedules and results.
